IB 2027 · SL

Unit 10: Binary Logic & Circuits

Themes A1.2-A1.3 | 3 Weeks (9 Lessons)

Unit overview

How do binary values and logic circuits become real system decisions?

This unit covers 5 IB Computer Science sub-topics: A1.2.1, A1.2.3, A1.2.5, A1.3.1, and A1.3.3.

The focus areas are Data representation methods, Logic gates, Logic diagrams, Operating Systems (OS) role, and Scheduling.

Coverage

  • A1.2.1 Data representation methods
  • A1.2.3 Logic gates
  • A1.2.5 Logic diagrams
  • A1.3.1 Operating Systems (OS) role
  • A1.3.3 Scheduling

Objectives and outcomes

Code What You Will Learn What You Should Be Able To Do
A1.2.1 Data representation methods Describe principal methods (binary, hex, decimal) of representing data.
A1.2.3 Logic gates Describe purpose and use of logic gates.
A1.2.5 Logic diagrams Construct logic diagrams.
A1.3.1 Operating Systems (OS) role Describe the role of operating systems.
A1.3.3 Scheduling Compare different approaches to scheduling.
